13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of

      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)

        The applicant seeks to add a brew pub, accessorv to the barista coffee shop, without a
      full- service kitchen, to the 1500 square foot Sip and Savor conimercial space on the ground
      floor of the 239-unit Rosenwald Court Apartment Building. There is no on-site parking
      and the building is approximately 42 feet in height.
